comparison.objective: Place a nickel interconnect strip on a 2×2 battery pack, spot-weld it to all four cells, and return the welder to its holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle and align a thin strip, regrasp and orient a two-probe welder, make four precise dwell contacts, and restore tools without disturbing the pack.
comparison.success_condition: Credit covers centred strip placement, four 0.2-second dual-probe weld contacts, and reseating the welder; full score additionally requires both arms clear/home and all parts still for one second, while pack knockover or lost parts score zero. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: This tests thin-part placement and repeated localized joining with a handheld welder, not counterholding a screw during jam-nut locking or verifying a retained gripper opening through repeated cycles.
